messages:
kevin: heads-up — saw a potential double-count when a session swap happens mid-stream + toolcall.
kevin: router/v2/stream hands off to worker B -> toolcall executed, then worker A resumes and trims trailing tokens; billing shows tokens for both.
kevin: small sample logs attached below
sam: can you paste the logs + request ids?
maria: are we sure this is not just provisional->confirmed duplicate in ledger?
kevin: request id root=abc123, session_swap=swap-2026-03-18T10:04Z. logs:
sam: ```
[2026-03-18T10:04:05Z] router: route session root=abc123 -> workerA
[2026-03-18T10:04:06Z] workerA: streaming chunk seq=1 toolcall start id=tool-99
[2026-03-18T10:04:07Z] router: session handoff -> workerB (sticky expired)
[2026-03-18T10:04:08Z] workerB: executes toolcall id=tool-99 -> returns 42 tokens
[2026-03-18T10:04:09Z] workerA: resumes, applies trim suffix, reports stream end
[2026-03-18T10:04:10Z] billing: provisional charge 42 tokens for tool-99 (workerB)
[2026-03-18T10:04:11Z] billing: confirmed charge 42 tokens for stream root=abc123 (workerA)
```
anna: oh interesting — workerA confirmed after workerB provisional. Looks like confirmation flow double-counts when toolcall is executed on the fallback worker.
maria: could be this commit https://internal.git/repo/commit/7a8b that changed confirmation ack ordering (ping @kevin)
kevin: yep that commit changed when stream-confirm happens (moved outside session-lock). :grimacing:
ops-bot: FYI created ticket INFR-1123 to track (linked docs + logs)
billing-bot: provisional->confirmed de-dup id heuristic says dedupe by toolcall id+session, but we saw toolcall id repeated across worker contexts
sam: proposal: include origin-worker-id and sequence-number when creating provisional ledger entries so confirmation must match both
anna: +1. Also we should ensure toolcall id generation is globally unique across session handoffs (maybe include epoch counter)
maria: UI/console impact — console shows two separate charges in timeline; support will get tickets
kevin: short-term mitigation: guard confirmation path to prefer provisional entry if any match on toolcall id regardless of worker (patch incoming)
sam: can we add unit test simulating swap mid-toolcall? I'll write an integration test in router/test/swap_toolcall_test.go
kevin: thanks — will also add telemetry tags: "session_swap", "toolcall_origin_worker", "provisional_id" so we can query later
anna: ok sounds good. assign INFR-1123 to kevin and add docs for the rollback plan
maria: thx all :thumbsup:
